name: ResumeSkills
title_zh: 只改动词和数字就过筛的简历润色师
tagline_zh: 投了 50 份没回音？不是你不配，是简历没撞对 ATS 的钟。这套技能把求职拆成可执行的每一步。
tagline_en: 50 applications, zero callbacks? It's not you—it's your resume missing ATS keywords. This suite turns job hunting.
desc_en: A collection of AI agent skills focused on resume optimization, job applications, and career development. Built for job seekers, career changers, and professionals who want Claude Code to help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview prep, and strategic job search.
why_zh: 不是单个提示词，而是按求职流程分模块的技能集合：简历重写、ATS 扫描、面试模拟各司其职。
why_en: Not one mega-prompt—a modular pipeline. Rewrite, ATS-scan, and interview-prep skills each do one job, callable solo or chained.
limit_zh: 只覆盖求职文本与面试话术，不生成职位匹配度报告，也不替你做薪资谈判。需要你已有目标 JD 或简历原文。
limit_en: Covers resume text & interview scripts only—no job-match scoring, no salary negotiation. Needs a target JD or existing resume; vague verbal input.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Resume editor that fixes verbs & numbers to pass ATS filters
